claims.text: The OrdersApiDiskFull alert is firing on orders-api with OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device.
The health check shows status degraded with failing components db and disk.
The disk usage check shows /var/lib/shoplite at 100% capacity.
A dry run of clearing the temporary directory lists accumulated junk pdf files and shows it would delete 64 files.

steps.instruction: Check the disk usage to confirm the problem.
steps.expect: Filesystem Size Used Avail Use% Mounted on tmpfs 64M 64M 0 100% /var/lib/shoplite

steps.instruction: Clear temporary files to free up disk space.
Check the disk usage again to confirm the fix.
steps.expect: Use% drops below 100% and available space is shown.
